title_en: MPF requests restoration of church that kicks off the Lavagem do Bonfim
text_en:
MPF requests restoration of church that kicks off the Lavagem do Bonfim

The Federal Public Ministry (MPF) has opened a civil inquiry to take measures regarding the conservation and restoration of the Igreja Matriz Nossa Senhora da Conceição da Praia, located in the Comércio neighborhood.

An ordinance signed by federal prosecutor Vanessa Gomes Previtera requires the Irmandade do Santíssimo Sacramento e Nossa Senhora da Conceição da Praia, the entity that administers the sanctuary, to report within 20 days on the measures being taken to preserve the building, in light of the inspection by the Instituto do Patrimônio Histórico e Artístico Nacional (Iphan) and the Defesa Civil de Salvador (Codesal).

Also read: Urgent: man is shot dead during the Lavagem do Bonfim festivities

"Invisible heroes": check out street sweepers' accounts of the Lavagem do Bonfim

Faith and art: devotees use creativity to celebrate the Senhor do Bonfim

The Church of Nossa Senhora da Conceição da Praia is the starting point of the Lavagem do Bonfim, one of the most popular religious celebrations in Bahia. On Thursday, the 17th, hundreds of thousands of devotees took part in the procession that followed to the Basílica Santuário Senhor do Bonfim, a route of approximately 8 kilometers.

Every year, the ceremony begins at the church with an ecumenical act attended by authorities. In 2026, Governor Jerônimo Rodrigues (PT) and Mayor Bruno Reis (União Brasil) were present.

Origin

The origin of the cathedral dates back to 1549, shortly after the arrival of Thomé de Sousa, the first governor-general of Brazil. In 1623 it was expanded with the creation of the parish. Construction of the current temple began in 1736. The new church was inaugurated in 1765, still incomplete, and was considered finished in 1820.

title_en: Iapichino second with 6.90 in the long jump at the Diamond League in Stockholm
text_en:
Iapichino second with 6.90 in the long jump at the Diamond League in Stockholm

Larissa Iapichino confirms her excellent form, making her outdoor debut in the long jump at the Diamond League in Stockholm with an excellent second place, thanks to a mark of 6.90, second in the event only behind American Olympic champion Tara Davis, who won with 7.05, but leaving behind extraordinary rivals such as the German European outdoor champion of Rome 2024, Malaika Mihambo, fourth with 6.75, and the other US winner, of the world indoor championships in Nanjing 2025, Claire Bryant, fifth with 6.74. For the 22-year-old jumper from Florence, European indoor champion in March in Apeldoorn and fresh from her great personal best set in Palermo at the end of May with 7.06, with which she came close to the Italian record held by her mother Fiona May of 7.11, a performance of extreme consistency featuring several strong jumps: the opening 6.89 followed by the only foul, then her best attempt, 6.66, 6.82 and finally an excellent 6.85.

Another great Italian result in the Swedish evening comes from Giada Carmassi, who sets the new Italian record in the 100 metres hurdles with a time of 12"69 at the end of a race won by American Grace Stark in 12"33. The 31-year-old athlete from Friuli finished sixth, improving by a full 12 hundredths over her previous best set earlier this year, erasing the record set by Luminosa Bogliolo in 2021 when she ran in the Tokyo Olympic semifinal in 12"75.

Zaynab Dosso, European indoor champion in the 60 metres, closes her 100 metres race with exactly the same placing and time as in the Diamond League race held last Thursday in Oslo, eighth in 11"26, in a race once again dominated by the Saint Lucian Olympic champion over the distance, Julien Alfred, first with an excellent time of 10"75.

Federico Riva confirmed his great form, finishing second in his 1500 metres, part of the meeting but not valid for the final points classification, with a time of 3'32"17. He was beaten only by the Swedish home athlete Samuel Philstrom, winner with 3'31"42, but finished ahead of athletes of great calibre, especially his training partners, the Spaniard Mohamed Attaoui and the Briton George Mills, fourth and fifth respectively with 3'32"63 and 3'32"67.

For Riva it was the third top-level race in the last 9 days, beginning with the 1500 metres at the Golden Gala Pietro Mennea on 6 June, when he set his personal best in the 1500 with 3'31"42, and then just three days ago in Oslo, where he set the new Italian record in the mile of 1609 metres, with a time of 3'49"72.

title_en: Every life comes to an end
text_en:
Every life comes to an end

Croatian writer-director Daina Pusic, in Ayrılış, her first feature-length film, which she wrote and directed, depicts the unique bond between Zora, a single mother, and her 15-year-old terminally ill daughter Tuesday, portraying love through a poetic, surreal narrative.

Mother and daughter are very close to each other and love each other deeply. Unemployed Zora sells household items to pay the salary of the nurse she hired for her daughter. The scene in which Zora brings a set of Catholic bishop mice to her taxidermy shop to sell is very funny. Every day Zora leaves the house as if going to work, spends time in parks and returns home in the evening. One day, a giant macaw with very colorful feathers visits Tuesday, and after talking with the young girl, it shrinks to the size of a mouse.

FRIENDSHIP WITH THE ANGEL OF DEATH

Tuesday immediately realizes that it is her angel of death. The two become friends and chat. The parrot pours its heart out to Tuesday: "There are constant voices in my head, calling me from everywhere to take lives. It will go on like this forever; you silenced the voices in my head." Both of them enjoy sarcasm, listen to rap and smoke cigarettes. Thanks to the bird, the young girl understands that death is a natural process and feels ready, while the one who is not ready is her mother, Zora. Together they decide to prepare Zora. The parrot tells the young girl that the other world exists and that God is not in human form. "The echo you leave behind lives on through your legacy memories," it says. Zora will live in the other world just as she lives in this one, and Tuesday will be there too.

Pasic explores the themes of life, death, loss, guilt, denial, mourning, acceptance and farewell with the flavor of a fairy tale, and because she is a writer, the dialogues are both natural and literary. The ambient sounds are very well designed. Camera movements, close-ups and uninterrupted plan-sequences add motion to a film set in a single location.

Julia Louis-Dreyfus, famous from Saturday Night Live and the comedy series Seinfeld and Veep, who plays Zora, and young actress Lola Petticrew, who plays Tuesday, impress the audience with their accomplished performances. Arinzé Kene adds dimension to the parrot, which suffers in its voice and is tired of taking lives. In the final credits, Pusic uses Ice Cube's "It Was a Good Day" and emphasizes that death is as natural a process as life.

CAT AND MOUSE GAME

Hollywood loves to remake the best examples of European and Asian cinema. James Watkins' film "Sakın Ses Çıkarma" is a new version of the Danish film Speak No Evil (2022), co-directed by Christian and Mads Tafdrup. This time Hollywood has moved quickly. In its remake, Watkins' film, which preserves the satire and the exploration of social rules, is turned into a thriller, and the director explains that the audience will be frightened a great deal.

"I changed the harsh, sharp scene from the first film, and I did not make a dark ending," says the director, who has changed the original Danish and Dutch families into American and British ones.

TOXIC MASCULINITY

While Ben and Louise are on holiday in Tuscany with their daughter Agnes, they meet the English family of Paddy, Ciara and Bent. The children both have self-confidence issues: Ant cannot speak, and Agnes, although 12 years old, cannot let go of her cloth rabbit. These two families, who are polar opposites, become friends on holiday. Paddy invites them to the farmhouse in the English countryside. The countryside is lush and nature is wonderful, but the relationship between the families is strange. After a while, tension rises and the atmosphere becomes complicated and disturbing. In Paddy, James McAvoy reflects toxic masculinity at its peak. Louise, faced with her husband Ben's weakness, turns into a strong female bird protecting her family. A breathtaking, hair-raising cat-and-mouse game begins. Watkins' film Ayrılış, directed by Watkins and starring J. McAvoy, Mackenzie Davis, Scoot McNairy, Aisling Franciosi, Alix West Lefler and Dan Hough, should definitely be watched by fans of the thriller genre.

title_en: Benefits of red sage: the forgotten herb that boosts health
text_en:
Benefits of red sage: the forgotten herb that boosts health

Riyadh - Ahmed Salah - Red sage is considered one of the most beneficial medicinal plants, although it is often overlooked despite being found in many homes. This perennial herb, distinguished by its beautiful purple flowers, is not merely an ornamental plant but a real health treasure that can greatly improve your life.

Benefits of red sage for bones and joints

Among the most prominent benefits of red sage is its effective role in strengthening bones, especially for people suffering from osteoporosis. This herb contains vitamin K, which enhances calcium absorption in the body, helping to maintain strong, healthy bones. Even at an advanced age, regular consumption of sage can help strengthen skeletal health.

Antioxidants and delaying aging

The benefits of red sage are not limited to bones alone, but extend to protecting the body from oxidation. This herb contains antioxidant compounds that work to reduce the effects of aging, helping to regenerate cells and tissues. Adding sage to your diet can help improve overall health and reduce signs of aging.

Boosting the immune and digestive systems

Red sage is well known for its anti-inflammatory properties, which make it very beneficial in strengthening the immune system. In addition, this herb helps improve digestive health and relieve problems such as peptic ulcers. Experts advise including red sage in the daily diet to achieve the greatest health benefit.

Multiple medical uses

Red sage has been used in alternative medicine for centuries, especially in the Mediterranean region. It is beneficial not only for bones and immunity, but also for memory and concentration. This herb can be a powerful ally in improving general health and quality of life.

In short, red sage is one of the natural herbs that provide many health benefits, from improving bone health to strengthening the immune system. It is therefore worthwhile to incorporate it into our daily lives to boost our overall health.

title_en: Marcin Woroniecki: Match against Anwil? I count on an even fight
text_en:
Marcin Woroniecki: Match against Anwil? I count on an even fight

Zastal plays in Włocławek against the league leader. You come from this city, having played several seasons for Anwil. Will your heart beat faster in the Hala Mistrzów on Saturday evening? Maybe the stress is not as great as in the first match in Zielona Góra last year. But I will be playing at home, so I am already thinking about it. Anwil is the clear favorite... We, however, have a clear goal. We want to stay in the top league and play as well as we can in every game. We face a very difficult task, because we will be playing against the best team in the Orlen Basket Liga. I think they are still the number one favorite for gold. Of course, they may be going through a slight slump, since they lost in Lublin, but they played without two key players. It will be an extremely difficult game, but we have our own ideas for this match. We are going to fight, because we showed in our last two games that we can hold our own in an even fight against a higher-ranked opponent.

You surely know every centimeter of the hall in Włocławek. I have been shooting in that hall and at those baskets since I was eleven, so I know everything perfectly. It does not matter, though. You have to go out and play your game.

In Włocławek basketball is still the number one sport, right? Absolutely! All the people of Włocławek are very proud of this team. The support is huge: those four thousand people in the hall are only part of those who follow basketball in this city. You feel it, because wherever you go in Włocławek, the fans are there, and that is very nice.

Do you think Enea Stelmet Zastal will manage to stay in the elite? I hope we will not have to wait until the last round and the game in Ostrów. I count on us winning several games; I do not consider any other scenario at all. Since I have been following Polish basketball, Zastal has always been in the elite and playing for the highest goals. Let it stay that way.

title_en: Spurs await Thunder in West final after eliminating Timberwolves
text_en:
Spurs await Thunder in West final after eliminating Timberwolves

Los Angeles (Reuters) - The San Antonio Spurs proved they are ready to face defending champions Oklahoma City Thunder, exploiting an early sweeping offensive start and an excellent all-round performance to close out the conference semifinal series against the Minnesota Timberwolves, winning 139-109 in Game 6 played last night in Minneapolis.

The Spurs, the second seed, advanced with this win to the Western Conference final to face the Thunder, the top seed, who open the best-of-seven series at home on Monday. The two teams met five times during the regular season, including before the final of the NBA Cup, and the Spurs won the series 4-1.

Stephon Castle scored 32 points, the highest total in the game, and Victor Wembanyama added 19.

In another game, Cade Cunningham scored 21 points and delivered eight assists, leading the Detroit Pistons to a 115-94 win over host Cleveland Cavaliers in Game 6 of their Eastern Conference semifinal series. The Pistons, the top seed, thus extend the series to a decisive seventh game to be played in Detroit tomorrow, Sunday.

Jalen Duren scored 15 points and grabbed 11 rebounds, Paul Reed scored 17 points in 16 minutes, and Ausar Thompson added 10 points and grabbed nine rebounds, and had four steals, before being ejected due to accumulated personal fouls.

The Cavaliers, the fourth seed, lost at home for the first time in seven playoff games. James Harden scored 23 points for the Cavaliers, grabbed seven rebounds and committed eight turnovers. Donovan Mitchell scored 18 points, and Evan Mobley added another 18.

title_en: A bacterium destroyed millions of olive trees in Italy / The Puglia region is looking for solutions after losing millions of trees
text_en:
A bacterium destroyed millions of olive trees in Italy / The Puglia region is looking for solutions after losing millions of trees

One of Italy's most important agricultural regions is trying to reinvent itself after a bacterium caused one of the most serious plant health crises in recent European history. In Puglia, the region that provides roughly half of Italy's olive oil production, millions of trees have died, and millions more are doomed to the same fate.

According to an analysis by AFP, carried by Agerpres, the effects of the bacterium Xylella fastidiosa remain visible more than a decade after the first outbreaks appeared. Before the epidemic broke out, Puglia had about 60 million olive trees. Today, some six million have already died, and another 20 million are infected and gradually heading toward the same fate.

The region's landscape has changed dramatically. In many areas, once-green orchards have turned grey, and centuries-old trees have become dry trunks. "The further south you go, more than 100 kilometres, the greyer the orchards become," explained researcher Franco Valentini of the Mediterranean Agronomic Institute in Bari.

Specialists have identified the bacterium Xylella fastidiosa as the cause, a pathogen transmitted by certain insects that attacks the vascular system of plants. In practice, the bacterium blocks the circulation of water and nutrients inside the tree. The result is a slow death by dehydration and starvation.

According to researchers, the bacterium is believed to have reached Italy through an ornamental tree imported from Central America. Once introduced into the region, Xylella found ideal conditions for development in a territory dominated by olive monoculture. Specialists say that drought and high temperatures contribute to the spread of the disease. During very dry periods, vegetation becomes sparse, and olive trees remain among the few green plants available to the insects that carry the bacterium. Thus, climate change amplifies the effects of a crisis that is already difficult to control.

More than ten years after the bacterium was identified, researchers acknowledge that there is still no effective cure. Diagnosis and monitoring have improved significantly, but infected trees cannot be saved. At present, the main control measure remains the rapid removal of affected trees to limit the spread of the disease. Between southern Puglia, where the disease is already endemic, and the rest of the region, a buffer zone has been created under strict surveillance. When an outbreak is discovered, nearby olive trees are removed.

"We pulled them out by the roots; it is the only solution," said Mario Sannicandro, president of the Cima di Bitonto olive oil cooperative.

Xylella is not a problem exclusive to Italy. In recent years, outbreaks have also been identified in France, Spain and Portugal. However, none of these countries has recorded effects comparable to those in Puglia.

The European Food Safety Authority (EFSA) has identified about 750 plant species that can host the bacterium. This worries researchers, because the pathogen can adapt and find new host plants depending on local conditions.

title_en: "You were beaten by a Japanese! A Japanese!" The Land of the Rising Sun has been unbeaten against Europeans since 2019
text_en:
"You were beaten by a Japanese! A Japanese!" The Land of the Rising Sun has been unbeaten against Europeans since 2019

Japan's national team shows favourites how to play football

about 1 hour ago

Subscribe

The Japan national team has extended its impressive run of matches against European teams without defeat in regular time. In the opening round of the group stage of the 2026 World Cup, the Japanese side drew 2-2 with the Netherlands. For Japan, this result is another confirmation that the team consistently succeeds against European football sides on the international stage.

After the draw with the Netherlands, the Japanese kept their unbeaten run in regular time against European national teams, a run that has lasted since 2019. Over this period the team has played a number of strong matches against European opponents and has not lost once within 90 minutes. Within this run, Japan beat England 1-0, beat Scotland 1-0, thrashed Germany 4-1, drew 1-1 with Croatia, defeated Spain 2-1, beat Iceland 1-0, beat Germany 2-1 again, and now also shared points with the Netherlands.

The results against top European national teams are particularly telling in this run. The Japanese twice beat Germany, beat Spain and England, and did not lose to Croatia or the Netherlands. Such figures indicate the high level of organisation, physical readiness and tactical discipline of the Japanese team.

title_en: The real game was played outside the ground; 16,400 crore flowed out of the IPL | Madhyamam
text_en:
The real game was played outside the ground; 16,400 crore flowed out of the IPL | Madhyamam

Mumbai: The value of the Indian Premier League (IPL) is reported to be falling every year. Compared with last year, its value has dropped by 8 percent this year. In other words, the total value of the IPL industry has fallen from 82,700 crore rupees to 76,100 crore rupees. This is the second consecutive year that the value of the T20 cricket league has declined. According to a report prepared by the advisory firm D&P, the value was 92,500 crore rupees in 2023.

Two events that took place outside the cricket ground have wiped out about 16,400 crore rupees from the IPL's value in two years.

A ban on real-money games and the merger of major TV channel companies have been setbacks for the IPL sector. After Viacom18, led by Mukesh Ambani, merged with Disney Star, the Indian subsidiary of the US company Walt Disney, to form JioStar, competition for cricket broadcasting rights decreased. The ban on companies such as Dream Sports, which operated games like Dream11 and was a major IPL sponsor and advertiser, has caused losses of about 2,000 crore rupees. The report also makes clear that the halt of UPI transactions worth 10,000 crore rupees for games has badly affected fintech companies as well.

title_en: The Man Who Tells Stories With His Trumpet: Let's Get to Know Ibrahim Maalouf
text_en:
The Man Who Tells Stories With His Trumpet: Let's Get to Know Ibrahim Maalouf

An Arab young man trained in classical Western music brings together jazz and Middle Eastern motifs, producing a sound that is applauded around the world and that, when you close your eyes and listen, takes you on a serious journey. And here he is, Ibrahim Maalouf! This man, who has created a language of his own with the trumpet, knows no limits in music. Come, let's get to know him together!

Ibrahim Maalouf was born in 1980 in Lebanon. His family emigrated to France because of the civil war. Music is, in a sense, a genetic inheritance for them. His father, Nassim Maalouf, is a trumpeter, and his mother is a pianist. Ibrahim was captivated by the magic of the trumpet while still a child. But what sets him apart from other trumpeters is that he plays the trumpet with a fourth valve that his father developed. Thanks to this trumpet, Maalouf can play Eastern maqams with Western notes. He brings two cultures together in one instrument.

It is almost impossible to classify Maalouf's music by genre. You say jazz, but he moves you with Eastern melodies. In particular, the albums Beirut, Diagnostic and Red & Black Light tell a different story with every listen. At times he voices his family's hardships in Lebanon, at times love, at times the human condition, all through the trumpet.

Maalouf received classical trumpet training at the Paris Conservatory. In 2003 he won the Maurice André International Trumpet Competition, one of the most prestigious classical music competitions in the world. After this achievement, instead of continuing a classical career, he turned his course toward jazz fusion. In other words, instead of following the path the system dictates, he chose the path where his inner voice resonates.

Beyond his solo work, he has also made a name for himself through collaborations with major figures. Having performed with Sting, Salif Keita and Vanessa Paradis, Maalouf has also raised his profile worldwide.

Maalouf also composes film music. In 2015 he received the Film Music of the Year award. The background music of some productions we watch on Netflix may well be pouring out of his trumpet, even if we don't notice!

In Turkey he often performs at events such as the Istanbul Jazz Festival. He builds a warm bond with his listeners, because his music carries something of ours too. "I come from the Middle East, but I want to tell everyone's story," he seems to say. And indeed, his trumpet suits a Black Sea morning as well as a Damascus evening.

As the name suggests, it is a little harsh and a little heavy, but it has an impressive power. The clash between percussion instruments and the trumpet is almost mesmerising in his stage performances.

There is a rebellious energy in the electronic sounds of this song as well. It is especially a favourite of the young audience, since it is a kind of "I am here" song. Naturally, it also reflects Maalouf's activist side.

You should listen to these songs with headphones, without any distractions, whether on the balcony or under a bedside lamp. Because Ibrahim Maalouf's pieces are not just played; they must be felt.

title_en: Journalist picks the most beautiful kit of the Club World Cup; see the ranking
text_en:
Journalist picks the most beautiful kit of the Club World Cup; see the ranking

The FIFA Club World Cup officially began on Saturday (14), with a 0-0 draw between Al Ahly and Inter Miami. Alongside the action on the field, the website The Athletic, through English journalist Nick Miller, evaluated the 32 starting kits of the tournament in search of the most beautiful design. The shirt of Espérance Sportive of Tunisia was named the most beautiful at the event, mixing yellow and red with subtle black details.

"This shirt is simply magnificent. A marvel, a beauty, it makes you want to applaud, which would be strange, but still," said Miller.

Among the Brazilian clubs in the tournament, Palmeiras held the best position, in 16th place. They were followed by Botafogo (18th), Flamengo (22nd) and Fluminense (24th).

See what Miller wrote about the Brazilian clubs.

Palmeiras: "This shirt is quite pretty and, from a distance, could pass for something from the 1950s (as a compliment), but looking more closely, you will see a variety of designs in the background, incorporating several elements. It is a great way to introduce some variety into a classic and very straightforward design, even if that variety may go unnoticed."

Botafogo: "This is (a model) perfectly clean and manages not to look dull, even though it is just black and white with a few grey touches here and there. It is simply arranged beautifully: the stripes are the same size, the collar is sturdy, and so are the cuffs. You don't see many Reebok kits these days, and, based on this, it is a shame, because it could teach some other companies very necessary lessons about the virtues of the 'less is more' concept."

Flamengo: "Complicated. It's very basic. And there's nothing wrong with that. But it's very basic. Which can be a virtue. But it's very basic. I can't decide whether this is too basic or just a beautiful, clean, simple, uncomplicated idea... But wait, all of that is a synonym for basic, isn't it? It's very basic..."

Fluminense: "From an English perspective, it is very strange to see the name and logo of Umbro (an English company) on a Brazil shirt. It is a brand we usually associate with English clubs, and with England; in the 1990s, with affordable boots when you were a child; with a specific kind of basic training wear that migrated to the fashionistas of East London. It looks like a shirt made for children: very bold, thick blocks, the kind of football shirt Fisher Price (a toy company) could have designed. That doesn't mean it is bad, but... well, you may feel like a child wearing it."

Chelsea finished last. Their blue kit was rated "horrible", leaving Bayern Munich just above them in 31st place.

title_en: CGT and CTA join the UOM strike in Tierra del Fuego
text_en:
CGT and CTA join the UOM strike in Tierra del Fuego

In line with the Unión Obrera Metalúrgica (UOM) of Tierra del Fuego, which began an indefinite strike, organizations that stand opposite the ruling party said they will carry out a full strike. Unions in the province will stop work on (21/05) as a signal of rejection of the measures implemented by the Milei administration. The leaders of the CGT and CTA argue that it will be "in defense of sovereignty, jobs and national industry." In this regard, they warn that: In the face of the new attack by the National Government on the work and production of Tierra del Fuego, Antarctica and the South Atlantic Islands and on the people of Fuegian in general, the trade union and social organizations of the province express our absolute rejection and demand that all measures that attack industry, jobs and the dignity of thousands of families in our province be reversed. title_en: Analyst says war in the Middle East could push bitcoin prices up
text_en:
Analyst says war in the Middle East could push bitcoin prices up

Arthur Hayes, founder of BitMEX, believes that the outbreak of war in the Middle East could benefit the price of bitcoin. In his latest analysis he outlined his view of what could happen in the crypto market if the conflict between Israel and Iran intensifies.

Arthur Hayes, founder of BitMEX and a cryptocurrency expert, shared his views via dailyhodl. He believes that Iranian bitcoin miners, who account for as much as 7% of the global hash rate, will benefit directly from the situation. Although Israeli attacks would destroy the country's crypto mining sector, he does not think such attacks would affect the price of bitcoin.

"Remember when China banned bitcoin mining in mid-2021 and the hash rate fell sharply by 63%? The hash rate returned to its peak level in May 2021 only eight months after the mining group moved out of China, because other global players were able to increase their hash rate thanks to more favourable economics. Most importantly, bitcoin also set an all-time high in November 2021, even though the sharp drop in the network's hash rate had no visible effect on price. So even the complete destruction of Iran, by Israel or the United States, which would reduce the global hash rate by 7%, would have no effect on Bitcoin," Hayes said.

Hayes also said that he expects oil prices could rise sharply if the conflict expands further and leads to the destruction of the Middle East's oil infrastructure, and he believes that such an event would also push the price of bitcoin higher.

"Bitcoin is also classed as energy stored in digital form, so if energy prices rise, the price of bitcoin will rise in fiat terms. Mining profit will not change, because all miners face the same rise in energy prices together. That could be a challenge for some large industrial miners in finding energy sources, since utilities operating under government orders invoke force majeure and cancel contracts. But if the hash rate falls, mining difficulty will also fall, which allows new entrants to mine bitcoin."

title_en: US State Department: China must choose between Putin and the West
text_en:
US State Department: China must choose between Putin and the West

China must choose between Russian dictator Vladimir Putin and the countries of the West, reports RBC-Ukraine. This was stated by a representative of the US State Department, reports Newsweek. According to him, the US has reprimanded China for its continued support of Putin, who arrived in Beijing on Thursday.

"If China claims to want good relations with Europe and other countries, it cannot continue to pose the greatest threat to European security," said the US State Department representative. The official stressed that this is the position not only of the US, but also of the European Union, NATO and the G7.

Putin made his first trip after he "re-elected" himself for a fifth presidential term. This is happening against the backdrop of US attempts to continue isolating Russia. At the same time, the State Department representative said that Russia will make every effort to continue its war against Ukraine even without China's support.

The American official also said that no country should provide Putin with a platform to propagate his aggressive war against Ukraine, and that the US cannot return to normal business with the Russian Federation or close its eyes to the blatant violations of international law that Russia has committed in Ukraine. It must bear responsibility for war crimes.

The publication writes that during talks with Putin on Thursday, Chinese leader Xi Jinping praised the 75th anniversary of diplomatic relations between Beijing and Moscow and called for "close strategic coordination." Putin said Russia is ready to develop this cooperation "to help establish a fairer and more equitable international order." Relations between Russia and China

Thiruvananthapuram: A couple in Kerala has caused a stir by sacrificing two women in a human sacrifice driven by greed to get rich quickly. And yet more shocking information has come to light.

Ernakulam Police Commissioner C.H. Nagaraju said on Wednesday that a shocking new detail has emerged: the couple accused of the human sacrifice may have eaten the victims' flesh.

Police said the deceased, Roselin and Padma, were subjected to extreme torture, tied up, before being strangled to death. The women's organs were cut, allowing them to bleed. The police chief said one body had been cut into 56 pieces.

The main accused is Mohammed Shafi. He is a sexual deviant who remains perpetually unhappy. He brought the women to the home of Bhagaval Singh and his wife Laila. Shafi was out on bail in a 2020 sexual assault case involving a 75-year-old woman. Police said Shafi had committed sexual assault crimes before as well.

Promise of a film role

Shafi had promised the victims money to act in an obscene film. Bhagaval Singh and Laila were in financial crisis. Police said Shafi had suggested that they carry out a human sacrifice to get out of their troubles and become rich. For this he took two women to them.

Political connection of the doctor?

Massage therapist Bhagaval Singh is alleged to be linked to the ruling CPI(M). The party, however, has denied that he is a member. "He worked with us, but he was not a member of our party. After his second marriage he became a religious person. Perhaps it is his wife's influence," said CPI PR Pradeep.

Contact through Facebook

Shafi came into contact with Roselin and Padma through Facebook. He would trap women who were in financial distress. The investigation revealed that he also used his wife for this. It was through the same channel that he came into contact with Bhagaval Singh and his wife.

Karunagappally: One more person has been arrested in the case of a young man attacked with a soda bottle during a festival celebration over an old enmity. Akhil (21) of Karunalayam, Kottaykkupuram, Kulasekharapuram, was arrested by Karunagappally police.

On 2 March, during the festival celebration at the Adinad Shakthikulangara temple, a group including the accused attacked Chacko Zakariah, a native of Vallikkavu. Following the complaint of Chacko Zakariah, who was seriously injured, Karunagappally police registered a case and began an investigation; Akhil, who went into hiding during the investigation, was caught in Kizhakkekalla.

The team that arrested the accused consisted of Station House Officer V. Biju, Sub Inspectors Shameer and Shajimon, Assistant Sub Inspector Shibu, and Civil Police Officers Hashim and Prasanth. Karunagappally police said that two accused in the case had already been arrested and that the investigation is continuing for the other accused. The arrested accused was produced before the court and remanded.

Chennai: "I have taken up cases against ministers and former ministers suo motu only with the permission of the Chief Justice. I will not withdraw from the hearing of any case," Justice Anand Venkatesh of the Madras High Court explained.

During the DMK rule from 2006 to 2011, Thangam Thennarasu served as Minister of School Education, and K.K.S.S.R. Ramachandran served as Minister of Backward Classes Welfare. During this period, two separate cases were registered against them for accumulating assets disproportionate to their income.

The Virudhunagar District Anti-Corruption wing registered a case on 20 December 2011 against Minister K.K.S.S.R. Ramachandran, his wife Adhilakshmi and his friend Shanmugamoorthy, for accumulating assets worth 44 lakh 59 thousand 67 rupees, disproportionate to income, during the period from 1 April 2006 to 31 March 2010. Similarly, on 14 February 2012, the Virudhunagar District Vigilance police registered a case against Thangam Thennarasu and his wife Manimegalai for accumulating assets worth 76 lakh 40 thousand 443 rupees during the period from 15 May 2006 to 31 March 2010.

These cases were being heard in the Srivilliputhur court. Ministers Thangam Thennarasu and K.K.S.S.R. Ramachandran filed petitions in the Srivilliputhur court seeking to be released from the cases. The court hearing the case had ordered the release of all three accused: Minister Thangam Thennarasu and his wife, and K.K.S.S.R. Ramachandran and his wife.

While the Anti-Corruption department had not appealed these orders, Justice Anand Venkatesh of the Madras High Court took up revision petitions suo motu. In this case he had directed Ministers Thangam Thennarasu and K.K.S.S.R. Ramachandran and the Anti-Corruption department to respond, and adjourned the hearing.

These cases came up for hearing before Justice Anand Venkatesh on Wednesday. Senior advocate N.R. Elango, appearing for Minister K.K.S.S.R. Ramachandran, said, "The court has stated that the order issued by the lower court is illegal. There is a fear that this will cause harm to the accused. Therefore, the judge should recuse himself from hearing this case," and made this request.

Senior advocate A. Ramesh, appearing for Minister Thangam Thennarasu, argued, "If a matter that has come to the court's attention is taken up suo motu, it is for the Chief Justice to decide which judge should hear it."

The judge hearing the case then said, "I have taken up the cases suo motu only with the permission of the Chief Justice. I will not withdraw from the hearing of any case. If you wish, you may approach the Supreme Court and seek relief regarding these cases."

He then adjourned the case against Minister K.K.S.S.R. Ramachandran to 2 November, and the case against Minister Thangam Thennarasu to 9 November.

Madikeri: A terrible accident between a Swift car and a KSRTC bus occurred in Sampaje, a border village of Dakshina Kannada and Kodagu districts, in which six people, including a child, died, from among the four people in the car.

The tragedy occurred near the petrol bunk in Sampaje, Madikeri taluk. A head-on collision took place between a bus travelling from Sullia to Virajpet and a Swift car, number KA 01 AH 3898, coming from Madikeri toward Sullia. As the car that had come from the Madikeri side filled up at the Sampaje petrol pump and was pulling out onto the road, the bus travelling from Sullia to Madikeri hit it.

Three of the passengers in the car died on the spot. Three died while being taken by vehicle to the KVG Hospital in Sullia for admission. Three children, two women and one man died.

The incident occurred while family members of Kumar of Bheemanahalli village in Malavalli taluk and of Sheela of Kubereshana Koppalu village were travelling to Dharmasthala.

Moradabad: The SDM Ghanshyam Verma, who had a bulldozer run over the house of a furniture businessman in Moradabad, has been suspended after an inquiry.

The businessman had complained to the DM and the Commissioner.

The bulldozer was run on 12 July.

An SDM cannot run a bulldozer in a municipal corporation.

SDM suspended after inquiry

In Moradabad, Uttar Pradesh, the SDM Ghanshyam Verma has been hit by action after a departmental inquiry, angered by the furniture businessman's demand for money owed to him. SDM Ghanshyam Verma was accused of having taken goods worth around 2.67 lakh from a furniture showroom but of dragging his feet over payment. When the businessman Jahid Hasan asked for his money, the SDM first declared the businessman's house illegal and then ran a bulldozer over it.

In this matter, the businessman Jahid Hasan complained to the DM on 7 July that SDM Ghanshyam was misusing his powers and harassing him. However, in the complaint given to the DM, Ghanshyam Verma showed his strength and made his move before any action could be taken. Jahid, however, lodged a complaint with Commissioner Anjaneya Kumar Singh on 10 July.

Taking cognisance of the complaint, the Commissioner ordered the DM to have an inquiry conducted at the ADM level. The inquiry was then handed to SDM Surendra Singh. When the then SDM Ghanshyam Verma learned that an inquiry had been set up against him, the enraged SDM had a bulldozer run over the businessman Jahid's house on 12 July.

However, the inquiry conducted after Commissioner Anjaneya Kumar Singh's order found that Ghanshyam Verma had taken improper steps, after which he was removed from the post of SDM of Bilari late on Tuesday night. In the inquiry report submitted to Commissioner Anjaneya Kumar Singh, SDM Surendra Singh stated that SDM Ghanshyam had had a bulldozer run over the businessman's house, which falls within the Bilari municipal area.

The inquiry report, clarifying that an SDM cannot use a bulldozer to remove any encroachment in a municipal area because he does not have that authority, also states that the right to use a bulldozer to remove an encroachment in any municipal area lies only with the executive officer.

The inquiry report says that at the time the bulldozer ran, Ghanshyam Verma held the charge of executive officer for the Bilari area, but he had issued the demolition order as SDM, which is an illegal procedure. On the basis of this entire report, when he was found prima facie guilty, DM Shailendra Kumar Singh removed the SDM from the post of SDM of Bilari. Late on Tuesday night, Ghanshyam Verma was then suspended.

Across the country, the Chaitri Navratri festival is currently being celebrated with great enthusiasm. During this nine-day Navratri festival, devotees are flocking to goddess temples across the country. During this time, Durga Mata is worshipped in various forms.

About 80 km from Ranchi, the capital of Jharkhand, at the confluence of the Bhairavi Bhaida and Damodar rivers, there is a unique goddess temple. This goddess shrine, known as the Chhinnamastika Devi Temple, is said to be 6,000 years old.

As its name suggests, the goddess in this temple is without a head. It is said to be the second largest Shakti Peeth after the goddess Kamakhya in Assam. During Navratri devotees from across the country flock to see the Mother.

The uniqueness of the idol here is that in the hands of this headless idol is a severed head, and it is believed that three streams of blood flow from its neck. The headless neck of the idol is adorned with a serpent garland and a garland of skulls. The hair is loose and the tongue is protruding.

According to a mythological tale, Goddess Bhavani went to bathe in the Mandakini river with her two friends. Tired after bathing, the friends became very hungry and asked Bhavani to give them something to eat. Seeing her friends turning black from hunger, the goddess cut off her own head with a sword, and of the three streams of blood that spurted out, two went to her friends, while the goddess satisfied her own hunger from one of the streams.

The severed head is held by the goddess in her left hand.

The temple is mentioned in the Puranas. It is said that the temple existed in the Mahabharata period. Devotees believe that all the wishes of those who come to the temple and have darshan of the Mother will be fulfilled.
